extensions we cannot redistribute in a clean Code-OSS build, or telemetry/cloud agents
GlyphCode does not ship. verify-bundled-extensions.sh FAILS the build if any folder
under extensions/ matches a pattern below.
'patterns' are matched case-insensitively against each extensions/<folder> name as a
shell-style glob (so 'copilot' matches the folder 'copilot' exactly; use 'copilot*' to
also match 'copilot-chat'). Add a reason to keep this list auditable.
